answer: Dawn vine-anchor bond: a sponsor anchors newcomers, but standing rots. Newcomer posts 70; sponsor stakes 100 as anchor on the public vine, at most six. Each dawn reputation decays 10% and must be re-earned by honest work, or the stake burns. First fake 38, k-th 38+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,534,500 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-anchor ring fails: one anchor cannot carry two keys. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep the bond.
